options.label: Text
tooltip: In-game menus resemble the Original PC version.

options.label: Pictographic
tooltip: In-game menus resemble the 3DO version.

options.label: Disabled
tooltip: SIS display window is replaced by side menu window
during shipyard purchases only on DOS platform (default).

options.label: Enabled
tooltip: SIS display window is replaced by DOS-style side menu window
during shipyard purchases on all platforms.

options.label: Gradients
tooltip: Certain menu texts and dialogs use gradients,
as per the original PC version.
Looks nicer.

options.label: Flat
tooltip: All text and menus use a `flat' colour scheme as well as
the larger 3DO font, as per the 3DO version.
Easier to read.

options.label: Slides
tooltip: Prefer slides to movies if both are present.
Forces the PC intro.

options.label: Movie
tooltip: Prefer movies to slides.
Will use 3DO content if present.

options.label: Green Engine
tooltip: The Flagship's engine will be green as per the PC version.

options.label: Red Engine
tooltip: The Flagship's engine will be red as per the 3DO version.

options.label: DOS
tooltip: Screen transitions will be instantaneous.
Fades will use a Subtractive/Additive blend.
&!Fade style is always Alpha blend in SDL1 builds

options.label: 3DO
tooltip: Screen transitions will crossfade.
Fades will use an Alpha blend.
&!Fade style is always Alpha blend in SDL1 builds

options.label: Per-Page
tooltip: When fast-forwarding or rewinding conversations
in-game, advance one screen of subtitles at a time.
This mimics the original PC version.

options.label: Smooth
tooltip: When fast-forwarding or rewinding conversations
in-game, advance at a linear rate.
This mimics the 3DO version.

options.label: Disabled
tooltip: Do not load the 3DO Speech Pack.

tooltip: Use 3DO speech. The script is closer to 3DO
version where there are differences.

tooltip: Show subtitles for alien speech.
